Ravi (PM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 1— customers want clearer GA windows for the Hosted API streaming changes, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations. Can leadership give a short, bullet-style public timeline?
Lee (VP Product): Short bullets for public comms: Hosted API streaming improvements -> staged GA target late July 2026; Console cost visuals -> public beta mid-August 2026, GA end-September 2026; Optimize recommendations -> invite-only beta Sept 2026, broader beta Oct 2026.
Ravi (PM): Thanks. Any internal gating we should call out so marketing/sales know to be conservative?
Tara (Eng): For Hosted API streaming: gating = kernel selection stability + p99 latency regression <5% on 95% of workloads. Owners: kernel tests (Sanjay) and memory profiling (me).
Sanjay (Eng): Confirmed. I have one perf regression open around attention padding when sequence lengths vary widely; fix in PR734. Will validate in CI canary.
Lee (VP Product): Console gating = RBAC + enterprise telemetry (audit logs), legal signoff on any customer-facing cost comparisons. Optimize gating = 30 days of stable metrics retention + privacy review.
Ellen (Customer Success): For customer notices, customers expect 30 days for private deployments and 14 days for hosted changes that are opt-in. We should prepare a migration FAQ and an "opt-in early access" form.
Samira (DevEx): Docs plan: publish an "alpha" surface now for SDKs with clearly marked breaking changes timeline, then a GA docs push once kernel/perf is validated. I'll coordinate with SDK owners to freeze breaking changes during the beta window.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-06-28T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-30T02:00:00Z, target 2% traffic, opt-in pools only.
Tara (Eng): Note: canary will include tracing and automatic rollback hooks. If we see p99 > 2x baseline we will abort.
Ravi (PM): Action items: Sanjay to confirm PR validation and timeline, Tara to own canary runbook + rollback thresholds, Samira to draft docs + migration FAQ, Ellen to prepare customer notice templates. I'll assemble a customer-friendly timeline by Friday and share in #product.
Lee (VP Product): One more thing: label Console cost visuals as "beta" in marketing until we have billing schema and legal privacy check complete. Also avoid hard dates in public comms if canary is still running.
Ellen (Customer Success): Will do. I'll prepare both a conservative and an optimistic timeline for account teams.
Ravi (PM): Thanks all. I'll post the finalized timeline and the action tracker later today. :white_check_mark:
